name: Hello Dungeon
description: The example addon: imports plain-text stat blocks into a workshop, builds cavern maps with a picture and a small 3D model, and draws the board in an isometric view.
author: Open Dungeon Master

settings.label: Wall colour
settings.help: The colour the cavern generator paints walls in.

settings.label: Floor texture
settings.help: Painted by its setup into its asset library, for the isometric view. Changing it runs the setup again.

workshopImporters.title: Plain-text stat blocks
workshopImporters.description: A .txt or .md file of '# Monster:' and '# Lore:' sections becomes a workshop of monsters and lore.

options.label: Ask the storyteller for a blurb
options.help: Uses this server's model (the ai.text permission) to write the workshop's one-line description.

mapGenerators.title: Example cavern
mapGenerators.description: A cave grown from the seed, with a painted picture and a small 3D model for the isometric view.

options.label: Openness
options.help: How much of the ground is open floor, in percent.

boardViews.title: Isometric
boardViews.description: The board drawn at an angle, walls standing up. Tap a square or a figure as you would on the flat board.

boardViews.title: Isometric session
boardViews.description: The same board with native Party, Chronicle, controls and composer in the session stage layout.
